name: vllm_moe_sum
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench vLLM test_moe_sum.py. MoE sum reduction: sums topk expert outputs (input shape [num_tokens*topk, hidden_size]) down to [num_tokens, hidden_size]. Reference calls vLLM _custom_ops.moe_sum(input, output) which writes into the preallocated output buffer. Source parametrizes num_tokens in {1,128,1024,5333}, hidden_size in {32,512,4096}, topk in {2,4}, dtype in {fp16,bf16}. Requires vLLM at eval time.
